definition: The Information Retrieval Facility (IRF), founded 2006 and located in Vienna, Austria, was a research platform for networking and collaboration for professionals in the field of information retrieval.

explainer.lead: The Information Retrieval Facility was a Vienna-based research platform founded in 2006 for networking and collaboration among information retrieval professionals. It matters as an example of institutional infrastructure built around IR research.

tiers.eli5: It was a meeting place for people who search and organize information, set up so they could work together.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers did not use it as a tool in systems; it served as a collaborative research platform. Its notable fact is that it ceased operations in 2012.
tiers.paperLevel: Founded 2006 and located in Vienna, Austria; a research platform for networking and collaboration for professionals in information retrieval. It ceased operations in 2012.

explainer.example: An IR researcher joined the platform to collaborate with peers across institutions; after 2012, that venue was no longer available.
